name: Velora Nitely
summary: In the Undercity's Trade Quarter, Velora Nitely works the forge for the Forsaken and the Horde. Once among Lordaeron's finest armorsmiths, she now makes dry jokes that rarely land.

sections.title: A Smith of Lordaeron
sections.body: Velora Nitely works near the anvils in the Undercity's Trade Quarter, where she makes armor for the Horde. Before the Third War devastated the north, Lordaeron celebrated her as an exceptional armorsmith. Undeath took her life and warmth, but left her technical skill untouched. She works with Horde crafters across continents, including Thun'grim Firegaze in the Barrens. Her craft includes reinforcing heavy battle plate and forging the formidable Brutal Legguards from hardened materials such as Dragonmaw shinbones.

sections.title: Deadpan Humor
sections.body: Velora Nitely keeps trying to make jokes at the forge, though her humor rarely lands. Many of her somber Forsaken kin brood over their cursed fate, but she still makes room for levity. Death seems to have ruined her comedic timing: her quips sound flat, morbid, and thoroughly unfunny to the living and the dead alike. She keeps cracking them undeterred.

faq.answer: Velora Nitely works as a Forsaken armorsmith in the Undercity's Trade Quarter. In life, she was renowned throughout Lordaeron for her extraordinary metalworking skills.

faq.q: Where can Velora Nitely be found?
faq.answer: Velora Nitely works near the forges and armor stands in the Undercity's Trade Quarter.

faq.q: What is her connection to Thun'grim Firegaze?
faq.answer: Velora Nitely is a Horde smith who aids the orc armorsmith Thun'grim Firegaze in the Barrens. She crafts Brutal Legguards for warriors who bring her Dragonmaw shinbones.

faq.q: Why are her jokes so bad?
faq.answer: Velora Nitely enjoys trying to make people laugh, but death took a toll on her delivery. Since rising into undeath, her jokes have been awkward and deadpan, and rarely funny.

angles.text: As a Horde warrior seeking the legendary Brutal Armor, you are directed north to Velora in the Undercity. She forges sturdy legguards from Dragonmaw orc bones.
As a blacksmith, you can see Lordaeron's armorsmithing tradition in Velora's precise metalworking, which endures long into undeath.
